principle: Policy code consumes canonical causal records. Agent adapters may normalize native events; engines may realize frozen plans. Neither may retune the policy.

must_match: policy revision and all policy parameters
primary_endpoints: official resolution conditional on each agent's FULL success

engine_axis.purpose: test physical realization of an identical frozen selection ledger
engine_axis.policy_source: one exported Paper 8.5 ledger; selector is not rerun per engine
engine_axis.failure_rule: Any logical-selection or logical-saving difference is an invalid cross-engine cell, not an engine effect.

publication_rules: Do not pool the historical mixed Qwen3-30B, Qwen2.5-14B and Qwen2.5-7B engine rows as a savings comparison.
Do not compare OpenHands tail-90 directly with mini-swe tail-95 or with a different task cohort.
Report agent-specific absolute token totals only within agent; compare fractions and normalized causal actions across agents.
A general policy may use only canonical roles, resources, effects, versions, dependency edges and protocol state; it may not branch on agent_id.
